description: Built on decades of Danish postal heritage, the Classic Pro Event Rear Drive transforms your entrepreneurial dreams into mobile reality. This electric-assisted cargo trike powers through the streets effortlessly. Hydraulic disc brakes and an 8-speed drivetrain keep you in control, while the 322-liter event box with extending shelves adapts to your business needs. Handcrafted in Denmark with premium aluminum, FSC-certified birch, and stainless steel components, it's built tough for the long haul. At 51kg and capable of handling 100kg payload, this is your ticket to turning ambition into action—one pedal-assisted delivery at a time.
